flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/TS/form/{TSForm,TSSummary,TSDetails}.tsx, pages/TS/list/TSList.tsx (Summary tab: notice list + Suspension Code, Day No, Remark; 'TS Confirmation' modal). ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not involved (this story is only the UI screen before the request is sent)
note: The story asks OCMS to show a summary of the notices, the number of TS days and special remarks (if any) so the officer can confirm. The staff portal TS page has a Summary tab that lists the selected notices (read-only) and a TS Record box with Suspension Code, Day No and Remark, all filled from the same form that is later sent to the backend. What the code does not guarantee: the summary is an ordinary tab, not a mandatory step. The 'Procced to TS' button is active on every tab and the confirmation modal only holds the generic text 'Do you want to proceed to Temporary Suspend the notice(s)?' without notice count, days or remark, so the officer can confirm without opening the summary. The suspension end date is not shown (the suspension_end_date field in TSSummary is commented out). No maintenance ticket changes this screen.
recommendation: Claimable for the summary display (notices, days, remark). Note that confirmation does not force the officer to view the summary and the modal does not repeat its content.

steps.step: The summary tab lists the notices the officer selected.
steps.detail: The Summary tab on the TS page renders TSList mode="SUMMARY" (read-only) with the notices the officer selected: notice no/summon/NTAC, notice type, date-time, place, rule code, vehicle no. Shown only when notices are selected (haveNotices).

steps.step: The summary shows the number of suspension days.
steps.detail: TSSummary shows Day No (number of TS days) from the form field day_no. It is pre-filled from noOfDaysForRevival of the chosen Suspension Code (TSDetails:72-73) and the officer can change it (required numeric input, TSDetails:103-108). The number of days is shown, not an end date (the suspension_end_date field is commented out at TSSummary:69-73).

steps.step: The summary shows the officer's remarks, if any.
steps.detail: TSSummary shows the remark field. The remark is optional (TextAreaInput without isRequired, maximum 200 characters, TSDetails:121-127), which matches 'special remarks (if any)'. Suspension Code + description is also shown at TSSummary:61-65 as an extra.

steps.step: The officer confirms before the suspension is applied.
steps.detail: 'Procced to TS' calls onConfirmation: validate() the form, then the 'TS Confirmation' modal ('Do you want to proceed to Temporary Suspend the notice(s)?'); only OK calls onSubmit (TSForm:231-234). But the button lives in the rightMenuSlot of every tab (TSForm:306-314) and the modal holds no notice count, days or remark, so the summary is not a prerequisite for confirming. A confirmation exists; 'confirm based on the summary' is not enforced by the code.
